lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the gill region, with centroid spacing increasing along the anterior-posterior axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with high-luminance blobs, forming a coordinate-like grid across the visible lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient, with higher intensity on the dorsal margin and lower intensity shadows on the ventral margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Several elongated dark features attached to the ventral-lateral flank and pectoral fin; irregular low-luminance patches on the posterior margin of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense cluster of small-diameter high-luminance spots located in the immediate post-branchial zone before the transition to larger grid-aligned blobs.
